addonDescription: Custom AIOStreams powered by Tamtaro SEL Setup v2.6.1. Features advanced filtering with Stream Expression Language and smart sorting with Vidhin's Regex Patterns. Your personal all-in-one setup for the perfect Stremio experience.

excludedStreamExpressions.expression: /*Bad 4k Anime*/ (isAnime and originalLanguage == 'Japanese' and count(quality(resolution(cached(streams), '2160p'), 'Bluray REMUX')) == 0 and count(seadex(resolution(streams, '2160p'))) == 0 and count(rseMatched(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'BD T1', 'BD T2', 'BD T3', 'BD T4', 'BD T5', 'BD T6', 'BD T7', 'BD T8', 'Remux T1', 'Remux T2', 'Remux T3', 'Web T1', 'Web T2', 'Web T3', 'Web T4', 'Web T5', 'Web T6')) == 0 )? negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams)), resolution(streams, '2160p')) : []
